done_when: Close no longer runs the full test command on the laptop when the pull request's CI runs it: it runs fast_test when set, otherwise only the test files the change touched and the tests named after its changed source files; CI still runs the full suite and a red CI sends the item back. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.
why: Each round runs the same tests twice, on the laptop and in CI, which is most of a round's time
